_comment: JUDGES/MENTORS PAGE COPY (English). REAL CONTENT, partially (2026): individual names are still unknown (not in any of the three given sources), so every person card stays a placeholder — but the COUNT of cards is now real, not arbitrary (sourced from the board-approved resolution for 'Taqathon 2', board minutes dated 2026-07-21: 5 judges for the final stage, 3 mentors across 3 specialized workshops). Previously this page showed 2 generic judge + 2 generic mentor cards (4 total, an arbitrary placeholder count) — now 5 + 3 (8 total), matching the sourced numbers. Split into two arrays, 'judges' and 'mentors' (2026-08-18, user request: 'divide up the judges and mentors' — they used to be one flat 'people' array, distinguishable only by each card's own role text) — judges.njk now renders them as two separate grouped sections instead of one mixed grid. hero.intro was also reworded this same round: it used to read 'Taqathon 2's approved budget provides for 5 judges...', which is internal board/budget language that has no business being customer-facing copy — flagged directly by the user ('why are you telling people this?'); see about.en.json, sponsors.en.json, and tracks.en.json for the other pages that had the same board/budget-approval phrasing leak into visible copy and got the same fix. No photo files exist yet, so each profile renders a generic Bootstrap-Icon avatar circle instead of a broken — once real photos exist, add a 'photo' path per person and swap the icon for an .
